description: The line plot, titled “BBQ,” illustrates the accuracy of four different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 1500 on the x-axis, which is labeled “#Demonstrations” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 45 to 55 and is also linearly scaled, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Four distinct lines represent different models: “Squared Exponential” (solid dark blue line with circular markers) starts at approximately 52.5 accuracy at 0 demonstrations, rises sharply to about 55.5 by 250 demonstrations, and then plateaus near 55.5 through 1500 demonstrations. “Tanh” (solid medium blue line with circular markers) begins near 49.5, slightly increases to about 50 by 250, then remains relatively flat around 50 through 1500. “ELU” (solid light blue line with circular markers) starts at approximately 47.5, rises slightly to about 48.5 by 250, and then stabilizes near 48.5. “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” (dashed pink line with no markers) remains nearly constant at approximately 46.5 across all demonstration counts. All lines show minimal variation beyond 250 demonstrations, with “Squared Exponential” consistently outperforming the others.
